B091FXH2FR.title: Kasa Outdoor Smart Plug, Smart Home Wi-Fi Outlet with 2 Sockets, EP40
bullets: INDIVIDUAL CONTROL OF 2-IN-1 OUTLETS: Control two AC outlets independently, with up to 15A/1875W max per outlet. Attached durable covers help protect the outlets from dirt when not in use, while IP64 weather resistance supports outdoor use.
Group Control: Group your Kasa smart bulbs, plugs, and switches together for convenient control. Turn multiple connected devices on or off simultaneously with a single tap.

Voice & Remote Control: Control outdoor devices with your voice using Alexa or Google Assistant, or turn them on and off from anywhere using the Kasa app, whether you are at home, in the office or on vacation.

App-Guided Set Up and Use: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connection required. Plug in, open the Kasa app, follow the simple instructions and enjoy the wifi smart plug. Ideal for landscape lighting, swimming pool pumps, holiday lights, or other appliances.

Scheduling: Use schedules or countdown timer to set your smart plug to automatically turn on and off at the time you want. Sunset/sunrise offset makes it even smarter to act according to the real daytime.
Trusted and Reliable: Kasa is trusted by over 6 Million users and being the Reader’s Choice of PCMag 2020. 2-year warranty.
For best performance, keep firmware updated by checking the Tapo or Kasa App.
